register.labelZh: TIP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: tip over 可以描述瓶子、椅子、箱子和小船失去直立位置。；tip up 可以描述獨木舟、木板、座椅或其他物件的一端向上移動。；tip something up 可以描述為了某個目的,小心把杯子、托盤或手推車傾起。；這些表達常用於談論打翻物件、搬動家具、小船和安全情況。
register.summaryEn: Tip over lets you describe bottles, chairs, boxes and boats losing their upright position. Tip up helps you describe the front or end of a canoe, board, seat or other object moving upwards. Tip something up can describe raising a glass, tray or wheelbarrow carefully for a particular purpose. These expressions are useful when talking about spills, moving furniture, boats and safety.

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Use tip over when something falls onto its side. Use tip something over when someone or something causes this. Use tip up when one end rises. Use tip something up when someone raises or tilts it.
